bio.text: Joseph "Dr. Joe" Arminio is the Republican candidate for Delaware's at-large U.S. House seat in 2026.
According to his campaign website, he was born and raised in Wilmington, holds a bachelor's degree in political science from Johns Hopkins University and a Ph.D. in political science from MIT.

His campaign site says he has taught at American University and Lincoln University, has authored seven books, chaired the National Coalition for Defense from 1996 to 2000, and ran in the 2008 Republican primary for Maryland's 1st District.
